learning_objective: Understand what a sunk cost is and why it should not influence future business decisions.
user_response: Sunk costs matter in business because they tempt decision-makers to keep investing in a failing project just to feel like the initial spending was worth it. Rational decision-making means looking only at what each option will cost and return going forward, not trying to recover what was lost.
